summary: Small family fastener firm (19.5 M EUR, 40 staff); we are 0.72 %. Calls us 'not strategic', quotes list conditions from stock only and won't extend individual agreements, yet its second shift is idle. 70610 is 14 % cheaper on the M12 bolt and 12 % on the M12 nut and is a candidate for our one-supplier kit; it is sole source only for the M16 bolt. Historically asked ~2.5 % and settled ~0 % on average. Lead with 70610.
notes: Contradiction: refocus on key accounts vs idle second shift wanting work. We pay late (avg 6.1 days, 57.5 % of invoices over 5 days), Delivery poor: OTD 75-84 % vs 95 % target, 80 complaints, 2 open 8D.
fears: losing M12 bolt and nut volume to 70610

evidence.quote: Their new sales director said Hollerau's volumes are 'not strategic' for Verbindungstechnik Mairhofer GmbH any more
price changes above 2 % need the approval of their pricing committee, which meets every two weeks
they could take additional parts at short notice; the second shift has been on hold since spring
Standard items will be supplied from stock at list conditions; individual agreements will not be extended.

levers: keeping the sole-sourced M16 bolt and a kit share
arguments: rival price: 70610 at 12.46 vs 14.52 (M12 bolt) and 4.91 vs 5.60 (M12 nut)
scorecard: OTD 84 % vs 95 % target, 80 complaints, 2 open 8D
notice period: price changes need written notice at least 60 days before year end (ctr 3.1)
avoid: changing terms after its final offer
tactics: Lead with 70610's lower prices for the same M12 bolt and nut and our plan for one kit supplier.
Expect 'half the step now, the rest next round' on the rival price; keep moving visibly.
Use the scorecard once: OTD 75-84 % against a 95 % target, 2 open 8D reports.
Offer a binding volume on the M16x60 bolt only in exchange for price on all three parts.
Keep steps near 2 % (pricing committee) and accept its final offer without reopening terms.
